descriptor_provenance: RBCLOSURE5I proved Run loads its dispatch flag word as R7=[Run arg0]. RBCLOSURE5J proves Run arg0 is StartInterpolation_Jolos original arg1, preserved unchanged through R6. The dispatch descriptor/flag word therefore originates upstream of StartInterpolation_Jolos.
local_write_guard: The visible StartInterpolation_Jolos body writes [original arg0 + 0x44] but does not construct the first word of original arg1 before calling Run; do not attribute R7 bits 4/5 to this function without upstream proof.
next_gate: Trace exact callers/references of StartInterpolation_Jolos at 0xffa1249c, recover the R1 argument source and the descriptor's first-word writes/constants, then determine whether Run bits 4 and 5 coexist in production command masks.
